newsitem.title: USA: Borden to sell unit to Mid-Am coop for $435 mln.
newsitem.headline: Borden to sell unit to Mid-Am coop for $435 mln.

text.p: Borden Inc, part of a dairy group owned by affiliates of investment firm Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co, has agreed to sell its Borden/Meadow Gold Diaries Inc unit to Mid-America Dairymen Inc for $435 million, the parties said on Thursday.

Under terms of a definitive agreement, Mid-Am, a dairy marketing cooperative based in Springfield, Mo., will acquire the Borden unit's 27 processing facilities in 11 states that produces a full line of dairy products, they said.

Mid-Am will also acquire the Meadow Gold, Viva, Lite Line and Mountain High dairy product brand names as well as a license to use the Borden and Elsie the Cow trademarks in the U.S. on certain dairy products, they said.
The deal is subject to customary regulatory reveiew and is planned to close as soon as practicable, they said.
Borden will use proceeds from the sale to pay down debt and invest in its businesses, they said.
Carl Bauman, president of Mid-Am, said purchase of the Borden unit "is an excellent opportunity for dairy farmers," noting that the cooperative has more than 17,000 dairy producers in 30 states.
"This acquisition fits our long-range strategic plan to expand our geographic profile and be a major marketer in the fluid milk sector of the dairy industry," he said.
C. Robert Kidder, Borden's chairman and chief executive officer, said the transaction furthers Borden's efforts to concentrate on the food and chemicals businesses.
Borden Inc is an umbrella group for 10 independent operating companies in the diversified dairy group, which was acquired by the privately held KKR in 1995.

The Borden group had sales of $5.8 billion in 1996 and produces dairy, pasta, snacks and other packaged grocery products. In addition, it makes consumer adhesives and wallcoverings and adhesives, resins and coating products for industrial users.
Mid-Am, with sales of $4.1 billion in 1996, supplies milk to bottling plants across the nation and is a major manufacturer of all types of dairy products.
